svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-02 Longitudinal control (ACC, Chill mode) under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4), phone view
svg.desc: 13 cards for F-02 Longitudinal control (ACC, Chill mode), one per SC guide word. M01 No Function: H-06, SG-06 ASIL C; callout: closes on the lead. M02 Stops Functioning: H-06, SG-06 ASIL C; callout: closes on the lead. M03 Unrequested Function: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B; callout: brakes for nothing. M04 Function Stuck: H-03, SG-03 ASIL C; callout: closes on the lead. M05 Excessive Function: H-03, SG-03 ASIL C; callout: closes on the lead. M06 Partial Function: H-06, SG-06 ASIL C; callout: closes on the lead. M07 Functions Early: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: brakes for nothing. M08 Functions Late: H-06, SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M11; callout: closes on the lead. M09 Function Applies Too Short: H-06, SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M02; callout: closes on the lead. M10 Function Applies Too Long: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B; callout: follower closes in. M11 Function is Delayed: H-06, SG-06 ASIL C; callout: brakes late. M12 Inverse Function: H-03, SG-03 ASIL C; callout: closes on the lead. M13 Erratic or Intermittent: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B; callout: surges: brake, go, brake.
svg.text: Guide-word scenes · F-02 Longitudinal control (ACC, Chill mode)
The 13 safety-relevant (SC) guide words. Chart: the function (acceleration command (+ accelerate, −
brake)), required vs performed. Scene: what it does to the car.
WP-C-03 §4 · hara_model.FM · schematic, not simulation output · phone view
No deceleration delivered when following a lead
Deceleration stops while still needed (e.g. stale
Braking with no reason (phantom braking), incl. a
stop from speed. Unrequested acceleration has the
same root but a different effect and is rated under

while the lead slows or stops.
Acceleration above intended, or acceleration from
acceleration while not engaged, including just after
a brake press has cancelled engagement (OS-13,
Deceleration below the required value when closing
Braking before there is a reason; same response as
Braking starts after it was needed; same as

Braking continues after the reason has gone;
vehicle slows or stops unexpectedly in traffic.
Scenes are drawn to explain each hazard; the plant runs are in assurance/sim §3.7. Ratings are proposals for review
